name: E2E Resume: Empty Artifact Counts as Incomplete
description: Executor runs resume.py in a fixture with an EMPTY product.md and a non-empty tech-stack.md. Passes only if the empty file counts as incomplete and next_step falls back to Product Definition (chain order). Regression test for the exists-means-complete bug.
executor_contract: argv: python3 skills/conductor-setup/scripts/resume.py; cwd: fixture with conductor/{product.md (0 bytes),tech-stack.md (non-empty)}; return: stdout text
